shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for path in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$path" ]; then cat "$path"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat next.config.ts && git diff -- app/page.tsx && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

Path('tsconfig.json').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:tsconfig.json']))
shutil.rmtree('.next')
Path('next-env.d.ts').unlink()
PY

git diff --check && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import { writeFileSync, rmSync } from \"node:fs\"; import { execFileSync } from \"node:child_process\"; writeFileSync(\"tsconfig.json\", execFileSync(\"git\", [\"show\", \"HEAD:tsconfig.json\"])); rmSync(\".next\", { recursive: true }); rmSync(\"next-env.d.ts\");' && git diff --check && git status --short"
